facts.fact: CRAN's Regulations regarding Accreditation of Security Products and Services (General Notice 953 of 17 December 2025) were made under Chapter 5 of the Electronic Transactions Act 4 of 2019, covering application, issue, renewal and revocation of certification service provider accreditation.
The Act's Chapter 5 and these regulations came into force on 15 June 2026 via General Notice 182/2026.
